commands.name: cmd_171
commands.meaning: Sets the current Life (byte at save+0x1fcc8, handler 0x39a584 -> 0x567908). Life intros call it first; 173 grants rank skills for the current Life (inferred from 0x2ffa64/0x1fb528 gate).

commands.name: actor_action

commands.name: actor_action_timed
commands.meaning: Immediate action for duration <=0, otherwise uses 0x468280. Action semantics depend on actor.

commands.name: actor_action_stop
commands.meaning: Stops selected actor action; -1 stops listed action slots via 0x467d20.

commands.name: actor_place
commands.meaning: Queues NPC placement through 0x2383f4. XYZ divided by 1000; slot -1 maps to -2. Bounds apply. First ID <2792, map ID <287; NPC definitions select the unit.

commands.name: actor_spawn
commands.meaning: Queues NPC at locator via 0x2383f4; slot -1 maps to -2. Requires compatible unit resources. First ID <2792, map ID <287; NPC definitions select the unit.

commands.name: npc_spawn
commands.meaning: Queues NPC spawn via 0x230548 (event 0x1e); NPC ID <2792, map ID <287, slot -1 maps to -2. Locator variant acts only when target map is current. Enemy units remain a separate placement/type-12 path.

commands.name: npc_spawn_locator
commands.meaning: Queues NPC spawn via 0x230548 (event 0x1e); NPC ID <2792, map ID <287, slot -1 maps to -2. Locator variant acts only when target map is current. Enemy units remain a separate placement/type-12 path.

evidence.note: Handler and argc are exact EU metadata for every slot. Names are inferred and separately confidence-rated; unknown commands are intentionally unnamed.

free_life_v4_research.supersedes: v3 meaning fields for natives 171/173/481; retained historically above

183.field: profile + 0x0c + 8*skill (signed byte level); XP float at profile + 8 + 8*skill; save profile equivalent: save+0x1fb24+8*skill for level, save+0x1fb20+8*skill for XP
183.profile_save_block: save + 0x1fb18; same profile has Life ranks at +0x130 (save+0x1fc48); save block used by 0x11efcc..0x11efe0
183.requirements: Active player stat component (byte +0x8c nonzero, profile pointer +0x94); global player lookup at 0x567abc..0x567ae8. No current-Life or quest-phase test. cmd_183 also appends to script-local eight-slot report queue at 0x450818, after the actual level write.

191.requirements: Explicit ability id; no Life/phase requirement. Dispatches notification type 13 via 0x2afa80; also script-local queue 0x450720.

173.correction: Rank byte writer 0x2c8920; rank table techniques at +0x14 processed by 0x2c8990..0x2c89a0 -> 0x238bdc (same ability-bit writer as 191). It does not call skill-level writer 0x287ff0. 0x1d6d34 is a notification path, not proof of skill grants. Rank changes also run craft recipe refresh 0x242d3c. Keep 173 for Novice rank/techniques/recipes.

481.correction: Craft rank-row notice (UI type 14); no skill level write. Handler flags are script-manager-local, NOT save fields. Persistent rank techniques come from 173.

181.requirements: Explicit item id/quantity, may yield for inventory overflow. Helper 4168 adds item_notice(199 is unrelated), toggles option 14 and debug output; replay uses persistent item_change only.

178.requirements: Active player stat component; add 500 once per Life. Helper 4338 adds pure notice native 484.

4219.note: Notice type 9 then persistent native 183; debug_line only after write.

4168.note: Option14 input lock, item_notice, debug_line around persistent 181.

4549.note: 87 uses current-Life switch to choose challenge; 347 requests UI35 (0x39cd68 -> 0x2478a8/0x22add8), then 481 only for craft Lives. Replay explicit challenge87; retain rank173 recipe refresh.
